test_title: PYST 07: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'CHOSEN' is coded as 'YTMIWN' and 'COMMON' is coded as 'YMOOMN'. How will 'CLIENT' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/986e954f85720dd91befe36b31120df9fb83f728d6842f3b0c554810aa367f8c.png] 

Logic followed here is that the next number is opposite + 1.

Given,

'CHOSEN' is coded as 'YTMIWN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c3b7de6e3dfd23b167b4a643fe4413646b7bf7958c86dbfff565803fb70686b.png] 

For, 'COMMON' is coded as 'YMOOMN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e90d0a4f1dae14e27a08a247865c4fb4d72ea411236bef10c1890adc9af736a7.png] 

Similarly, for 'CLIENT' is related to YPSWNH.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11a080c603fbc2718ccdc678853530fd94ade130391f7f26991aa9d03e091dd5.png] 

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
